title: Numeric cipher sheet on the relief of Philippsburg in HStAD D 4 Nr. 76/6 (Landgraf Philipp of Hesse-Butzbach, "Varia"), read with the key strip of the same file

documents.shelfmark: Hessisches Staatsarchiv Darmstadt, D 4 Nr. 76/6 (Arcinsys he:v5549727), view 13 (film frame 0416)
documents.date: 1641 (file), 1633/34 suggested by Brice Dudout, not checked
documents.route: unnamed writer -> unnamed addressee (relief of Philippsburg)

plaintext.source: No decipherment on the sheet; the key strip is on view 11 of the same file.

transcription.source: Claude (Opus 5.5) for Brice Dudout, 17 Nov 2026: two passes on different crops by the same reader, arbitrated on the image
transcription.notes: Digitised microfilm (DDB / Archivportal-D IIIF, region crops at 3500 px). Blot and hole on lines 1, 7-8, 20, 24, 26-28. Pass differences: transcription/pass_differences.md.

system.summary: Two-digit numbers for letters, a=11 ... z=34 in alphabetical order (24 letters), written contiguously with dots between words; 38 and 39 as second o and u; overbar doubles a letter.
system.notes: The key strip on view 11 gives 11-34; 38 and 39 are deduced from the sheet. One number 398 on a slip is off the key.

prior_solution.where: Key strip on view 11 of the same file; no reading found in the repository or in print

conditions.human_role: Brice Dudout chose the file from the German portals sweep and set the rules; Claude found the key strip, transcribed, decoded and read.
models: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic), agents run by Brice Dudout

solution.what: 68 views of D 4 Nr. 76/6 fetched from the DDB IIIF server; region crops of view 13 at full resolution.
Key strip a=11 ... z=34 found on view 11 of the same file.
Two passes on different crops, arbitrated on the image (transcription/).
Key applied to the whole sheet: 667 of 682 numbers in 11-34; 38 and 39 deduced as o and u from 14 contexts; continuous German.
124 words: 97 sure, 16 probable or restored, 11 unresolved (reading.md; 95 sure before the blind shape check answered by Brice Dudout, 18 Nov 2026).
Repository (Arcinsys record only), quick web search and own folders: no reading or edition found.

Second blind shape check of 9 boxed numbers (3 controls as expected) answered by Brice Dudout on a new scan sent by HStA Darmstadt: mittwoch sure (98/124); geschossen and Hagenaw confirmed on the new scan; decembris written decemmris; the sign after it unresolved.

outcome.method_basis: Key strip on view 11 of the same file.
outcome.fraction_read_source: reading.md: 98 sure of 124 words (97 after the blind check of 18 Nov 2026, 95 before; mittwoch made sure by the blind check of 25 Nov 2026) (repository rule, sure words only); with probable words 113/124 = 0.91, letter body lines 1-25 105/109 = 0.96

gaps.detail: blot, hole and pasted slip on lines 7-8, 20, 24, 26-28 and the two slips; 398 off the key
1641 from the file; 1633/34 suggested by Brice Dudout from the content, not checked

outcome.notes: Microfilm images only (black and white); a better image of view 13 could settle lines 1, 7-8, 20, 24 and 26-28.

texts.label: Letter on the relief of Philippsburg (HStAD D 4 Nr. 76/6, view 13)
texts.summary: The writer has been at Zabern pressing the Imperial and Spanish commanders for the relief of Philippsburg; regiments are on the march; officers and soldiers are to be encouraged to hold until New Year; their money is ready.

reading_review.note: Known key; two passes by the same reader; not a second reader. 18 Nov 2026: blind shape check of 15 boxed numbers answered by Brice Dudout (3 controls as expected); 2 words made sure, see reading.md; sheet, key, answers and hashes in blind_check/. 25 Nov 2026: second blind sheet of 9 boxed numbers on a new scan from the archive (3 controls as expected); mittwoch made sure; geschossen, Hagenaw and the date confirmed on the new scan (to be counted with its transcription), see reading.md and blind_check/.

credits.note: Key strip found in the file, transcription, decoding and reading (Claude for Brice Dudout). Images: Hessisches Staatsarchiv Darmstadt, via Deutsche Digitale Bibliothek / Archivportal-D.
